Faits vérifiés : passer d'une tâche à l'autre coûte du temps à chaque changement (Rubinstein, Meyer et Evans, Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance 2001) ; une marche dans la nature améliore l'attention par rapport à une marche en ville (Berman, Jonides et Kaplan, Psychological Science 2008). en.titre: 6 wellness habits that make you more focused in a week

paragraphes: studies found that switching between tasks _costs you time_ every single time
a study found that a walk in nature _improved attention_ more than a walk in the city
15 minutes, _no phone_, trees if you can
your thoughts get slower and _more organised_ on paper
in busy weeks i never knew when to fit my runs, so _i skipped them all_
my tip: a running coach app like Atala plans _your whole week_, so the runs just fit in

en.intro: a library, a café corner, _a desk by a lamp_
paragraphes: the same place every time tells your brain _it's focus time_
close the laptop, turn on a lamp, _read something for you_
